integrity: The proof is analytic and self-contained. The \(q=4\) consistency check is not used to infer the general theorem. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the real two-coordinate Luxemburg norm with exponents \((2,q)\), \(q>2\); no claim is made for general exponent pairs, higher dimensions, or arbitrary Musielak--Orlicz functions. An equivalent result under convex-body terminology remains a residual literature risk.
title: Exact Euclidean Banach--Mazur distance for the \((2,q)\) Nakano plane
